ss5Journey.planText: route vocals to a new bus; EQ + compressor on it; send to a reverb bus; automate the bus fader with Write while playing; solo-safe the reverb; export
ss5Journey.route: Step 3–4: a bus from the strip menu; track 1's OUTPUT slot routes it there (Step 9 also exercises the header's Route to New Bus and the send well's New Bus, each undone in one step)
ss5Journey.eqAndCompressor: Step 7–8: EQ then a Compressor in the bus's slots; their editors (response, gain-reduction face, reorder by drag, presets, sidechain)
ss5Journey.reverbSend: Step 14: track 1's next empty send well makes a NEW reverb bus (Bus 2) and sends to it; the bus takes a Reverb
ss5Journey.writeAutomation: Step 14: mode Write from the lanes' chooser; Bus 1's fader ridden by its knob while the song plays; at stop a Bus Fader lane holds the ride (31 points on the certifying run) and Write returns to Touch
ss5Journey.soloSafe: Step 14: a new bus is born solo-safe (R10); the bus strip menu's Solo Safe turns it off and on again; the reverb bus ends safe
ss5Journey.export: Step 14: Export WAV through the native save chooser; the export finishes (probe export.count, 100%) and a 69.5 MB WAV of the 180 s song is on disk

sessions.covers: Steps 0–15: the strip anatomy, routing, inserts and editors, sends, solo UX, keyboard Control target, automation v2, the master strip (G4.7), SS-5 as written (G4 exit)
